description: Regression fixture guarding against a specific defect: an isomorph whose core (after trimming mismatched boundary characters) is an exact repeat long enough to be independently notable is really a plain repetition wearing mismatched characters at each end -- e.g. MHTZAITYDZYB / FHTZAITYDZYG is just the repeated string HTZAITYDZY with a different letter tacked onto each end. Reported by Moshe Rubin 2026-07-15; fixed by isomorph_search._is_disguised_repetition (Python) / isDisguisedRepetition (JS). At min_isolen=4 this ciphertext's only raw candidate is exactly this disguised repetition, so expected_results.raw is intentionally empty; shallow/deep pruning shrink other, unrelated candidates below significance too, so all three lists are expected to be empty.
